news.label: Blender 5.3 Officially Released
details: You can import PLY and SPZ files, edit them with Geometry Nodes, and render them in EEVEE or Cycles.
Glass and gems can now show rainbow-like dispersion.
A new node lets you control how a material reacts to light. Video editing also gains features such as ripple editing.

lines.say: Let's start with Blender, where version five point three has officially been released.

lines.say: Gaussian Splatting can now be imported natively, and you can even edit it with Geometry Nodes.

lines.say: That makes it much easier to bring three D scenes captured from photos into your projects.

news.label: Gemini 4 Carbon Arrives
details: The model focuses on complex coding, long-running reasoning, and scientific research.
Google Antigravity has opened a preview of a feature that coordinates multiple AI agents.
In a public demo, it rebuilt an interactive Three.js space of about 900,000 polygons.

news.label: DeepMind's Robot AI
points: Tested on over 200 kinds of tasks
details: Gemini Robotics 2.5 widens the range of tasks it can handle, including using tools and manipulating soft objects.
In a demo on a Mercedes-Benz production line, Apptronik's humanoid robot Apollo 2 sorted car parts. The figure applies to specific conditions, and availability is limited to partners.

news.label: LingBot-Touch Released
points: Unifies different sensors in one form
details: Robbyant, part of Ant Group, released it as open source, along with inference code and a pretrained model.
It converts data from magnetic, piezoresistive, and visuotactile sensors into a shared representation that can plug into existing robot control AI.
It was pretrained on about 5,000 hours of tactile data.

details: Sales started on the official store at 11 p.m. on November 10.
